entities.text: Adapala Madhava vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
This criminal petition is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking to quash the proceedings against
the petitioners/Accused in CC.No.102 of 2018 on the file of the I Additional Judicial First Class
Mag
. The offences alleged are under Sections 420, 272, 273 and 188 IPC and Sections 57, 58, 59 & 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
This Court has heard Sri Raja Reddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor for respondent-State.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in a similar case, this Court, by virtue of common order in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein by considering that transportation of Gutka is not attracted by the offences alleged under Sections 188, 270 and 273 of IPC and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A perusal of the order shows that this Court, by considering that transportation of Gutka does not attract the offences alleged, quashed the proceedings.

Hence, following the said order and in terms thereof, the criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner-Accused CC.No.102 of 2018 on the file of the I Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Tenali, are hereby quashed.

entities.text: I Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Tenali
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: As a sequel, the miscellaneous applications, if any pending, shall stand closed.
D.V.S.S.SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 24.07.2019 KLP Adapala Madhava vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
